userStories.title: Correct outer-timeout comment arithmetic in orch-recycle-watch test
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the outer-timeout explanatory comment in test/integration/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts to account for every internal waitForCondition wait so that the stated worst-case internal budget matches reality and does not mislead a future reader debugging a timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: The outer-timeout comment (near line 261) enumerates all five internal waitForCondition waits, including the two previously omitted 5000ms-default waits (has-session near line 185 and pgrep-initialUUID near line 195), and states the corrected worst-case sum of ~42s against the existing 45s outer timeout. The 45s outer timeout value is unchanged. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'timeout: 45_000' test/integration/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts]
Only the explanatory comment text is edited: no test logic, assertions, internal timeout values, or control flow are changed (the diff touches only comment lines). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

userStories.notes: Single file: test/integration/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts, comment block at lines 261-263. The five internal waits are: has-session (line 185, waitForCondition default 5000ms), pgrep initialUUID (lines 195-197, timeoutMs 5000), pgrep orch-recycle-watch (lines 216-218, 10000), session-marker change (lines 227-240, 12000), pgrep newUUID (lines 251-253, 10000). Corrected sum = 5 + 5 + 10 + 12 + 10 = 42s vs the 45s outer timeout. Comment-accuracy fix only: do NOT change the 45s outer timeout or any internal waitForCondition timeout value. The two omitted waits each use/pin the 5000ms default and contribute 5s each.
